items.stem: What does Polyneices ask of his father?
options: Pardon and help in his war on Thebes
A permanent place to live in Athens now
Antigone's hand in a new marriage pact
Money for the journey back toward Argos

items.stem: How does Oedipus answer?
options: He curses him
He blesses him
He joins his army
He sends Theseus

items.stem: Complete the line: “Because by right of _____”
options: friendship
primogeniture
conquest
ransom

items.stem: Complete the line: “As _____, while he, the lord of Thebes,”
options: captains
pensioners
heralds
elders

items.stem: What does Polyneices ask his sisters?
options: To bury him if the curse comes true
To come at once and fight at Argos
To strike Creon down in the grove
To forget him and leave him unnamed

items.stem: Why will Polyneices not tell his army of the curse?
options: A good general reports successes and conceals mishaps
He has already forgotten every last word of the curse
He does not believe a father's curse can ever stand
Theseus forbade him to speak of it at all in the grove

items.stem: Who, according to Oedipus, is the reason he will speak to Polyneices at all?
options: Theseus, who sent the young man to have word of him
Creon, who still waits with a Theban escort
The chorus, who have already blessed the young man's war
Ismene, who has asked him to join the sevenfold host

items.stem: Which play continues this story?
options: Antigone
Oedipus Rex
Medea
The Odyssey

items.stem: Whom does Polyneices name as the younger brother who ousted him from the throne?
options: Eteocles
Eteoclus
Capaneus
Adrastus

items.stem: Complete the line: “_____ all the plain that circles Thebes.”
options: Abandon
Welcome
Beleaguer
Honour

items.stem: Complete the line: “We all _____ thee to remit thy wrath”
options: accuse
adjure
banish
reward

items.stem: Why does Oedipus say he will give Polyneices any answer?
options: For Theseus’ sake, not from any love of the speaker
Because the chorus has already promised him a sure victory now
Because he means to join the war on Thebes himself at once
Because Creon has asked him to bless the seven spears now

items.stem: What does Oedipus say will happen to Polyneices and his brother before Thebes can be stormed?
options: They shall fall, the two of them, blood-imbrued
They shall take the city and rule it side by side
They shall be welcomed home by Theseus in Athens
They shall see Oedipus already laid in a public tomb

items.stem: What does Antigone urge Polyneices to do with his army?
options: Turn the host back to Argos, and not ruin himself and Thebes
Lead the seven spears against Athens before nightfall comes on
Leave the sisters as hostages with Creon's men in the grove
Ask Theseus to march as a captain of the whole Argive host

items.stem: What place does Polyneices say Mercy holds beside Zeus?
options: Mercy is called co-partner of Zeus's throne
Mercy is called a servant banished from the sky
Mercy is called a Theban law Creon already keeps
Mercy is called a gift Theseus can sell for gold

items.stem: Complete the line: “An exile, _____, and make me wear”
options: honoured
crowned
welcomed
cityless

items.stem: Complete the line: “’Tis thou hast made me _____ with woe,”
options: finished
honoured
conversant
silent

items.stem: Why does Polyneices' plea for mercy fail to move Oedipus?
options: Oedipus charges him with exile and will not remit his wrath
Theseus has already forbidden any son to speak in the sacred grove
The chorus has already sent the young man back toward Argos
Oedipus has already left the grove and will not return at all

items.stem: How does Polyneices treat the prophecy of mutual slaughter?
options: He will not yield to it, and he will not tell it to his allies
He dismisses his army at once and returns in haste toward Argos
He asks Theseus to hide the sisters before the coming fight
He laughs and says the prophecy has already failed for good

items.stem: What distinction must a reader keep between Eteocles and Eteoclus in this episode?
options: Eteocles is the younger brother who holds Thebes; Eteoclus is an Argive captain among the seven
Eteoclus is the younger brother who holds Thebes; Eteocles is a seer with a lightning lance
The two names belong to one and the same Theban prince in this scene
The two names belong to daughters still waiting inside the sacred grove

items.stem: Complete the line: “This curse I leave thee as my last _____:—”
options: pardon
ransom
bequest
tribute

items.stem: Complete the line: “Make your path bright if ye fulfill my _____”
options: pardon
hest
ransom
silence

items.stem: What does Polyneices mean when he says he must meet his doom mute?
options: He dares not whisper the curse to his allies or turn them back
He has already forgotten the words his father spoke to him here
He intends to let Theseus announce the curse in Thebes itself
He believes the chorus will speak the whole curse for him now

items.stem: How does Polyneices's burial request look forward without narrating the later action of this play?
options: It asks the sisters, if they reach Thebes, to grant him funeral rites
It tells us that the sisters have already gone home and buried him there
It reveals that Theseus will keep a tomb hidden from every later visitor
It announces that Oedipus has already been taken from the sacred grove

items.stem: What contrast does Oedipus draw between his daughters and his sons in the curse speech?
options: The daughters have tended and preserved him; he says the sons are no sons of his
The sons have fed him in exile; he says the daughters refused all aid to him there
The daughters have joined the seven; he says the sons stayed behind in Athens
The sons have already buried him; he says the daughters came far too late

items.stem: What is the effect of Antigone's exclamation that his purpose stands fast, once he has excused his silence to the army?
options: She names the choice as fixed and misguided after his excuse
She praises him as a general who has already won the whole city
She withdraws her plea and asks him to march at once against Athens
She tells the chorus that the curse has already failed for good now
